title: Plate sense
summary: Build a simple balanced plate using foods you can actually get.
objectives: Name three plate parts: energy foods, body-building foods, protective foods
Build one realistic meal from local options
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

A useful plate often mixes:
- **Energy** (grains, roots)
- **Body-building** (dal, eggs, beans, fish, dairy if used)
- **Protective** (veg, fruit)

You do not need perfect. You need more balance than only snacks.

quiz.prompt: Which plate is more balanced for a school lunch?
quiz.teachBack: Mixing energy + body-building + veg is a practical balance pattern.

reflectionPrompt: Describe one meal you could make this week with foods available near you.

supported.coachNote: Offer local food examples in each category.

steady.coachNote: Ask what is cheap and available this week.

fast.coachNote: Ask how to improve a snack-heavy day without perfectionism.

llm.tutorBrief: No body shaming. No extreme diets. Respect vegetarian/non-veg households. Keep advice general.
